notes.title: Times for this weekend’s Alpha Playtest!
notes.content: [p]Thanks again for all of your support for Arkheron’s reveal last week. It was amazing to see how many of you joined in over the weekend. We are playing again this weekend and want to let you know what to expect! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Playtest Times Per Region[/b][/p][p]Just like last weekend, our available playtest times are separated into three regions across the globe. This is a temporary restriction while we continue work on various systems and to make sure that we're being cautious as we invite more players from around the world.  You can read more [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3401450/view/503962497384973433"]in this post[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]The main things to note are that the playtest windows have been expanded and finish later. We have also done a few things behind the scenes that should hopefully make latency a bit better for players in South America. Please let us know what your experiences are! For example, some players noticed an animation-cancelling bug in the last playtest which will be fixed for this one. We are also trying to get an improvement in for the small text size on item tooltips. We think this improvement will make it in but it hasn't been through our internal testing process yet so it's too early to confirm as of the time of this post. We will have more information later in the weekend. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Share Your Feedback[/b][/p][p]We would love to get your thoughts about Arkheron! If you’d like to share them with us, please fill out this quick [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdNmncNxZ5XivWVewqGqd9yOHVPLr4ukkeF0vtQL9dtQ8w-bw/viewform"]feedback survey[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]See you in the Tower! notes.title: Thanks for playing! Come back next weekend!
notes.content: [p]We are so grateful for all the support we’ve received for Arkheron this week! We have been blown away by the response to our reveal and how many of you joined us for the first Alpha Playtest weekend. [/p][p][/p][p]This is the first time our team has seen 3,000 players online at once. It was a really meaningful moment for us. The turn out has completely exceeded our expectations and we can’t thank you enough! [/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce that we are hosting another Alpha Playtest weekend at the end of this week. We will share more details about playtest times, potential game changes and what to expect for regional support throughout the week. Keep an eye out! [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime - we’d love to know what you thought of Arkheron! You’re welcome to share your feedback on [url="https://www.discord.gg/arkheron"]our Discord [/url]or here on Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]What do YOU want to know about Arkheron? Let us know your burning questions and we’ll start putting more information together. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all of your support. We hope to see you again next weekend! notes.title: Performance, Bots, Server Support and Matchmaking
notes.content:
[p]Before our first Alpha Playtest Weekend starts tomorrow, we want to share some extra info on some things we’re working on in the Arkheron Alpha. Specifically- performance, matchmaking, servers and bots! [/p][p][/p][p][b]PERFORMANCE[/b][/p][p]Arkheron plays best when it's running at 60fps or higher, and optimizing the game to run smoothly on more machines is a top priority for us. However, the build is in its alpha state and we still have a ways to go to land some big changes that will help a lot. You may experience some crashes or even hangs as we work through stabilizing it on more machines.[/p][p][/p][p]As a temporary measure, we have raised the minimum specs to play Arkheron, but we do plan on lowering them after we land some of the larger optimizations in future builds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Recommended[/b][/p][p]Windows 10 or later[/p][p]Intel i5-9600K[/p][p]Nvidia RTX 2070 8GB VRAM[/p][p]16GB RAM[/p][p]SSD 25Gb[/p][p][/p][p][b]Minimum[/b][/p][p]Windows 10 or later[/p][p]Intel i5-7600K[/p][p]Nvidia GTX 1060 6Gb VRAM[/p][p]16GB RAM[/p][p]SSD 25Gb[/p][p][/p][p]We invite you to share your experiences with us on Discord or Steam where our team will gather and review them. In the meantime our team will keep working hard to make improvements in this area. 

[b]BOTS
[/b]Earlier this year, we were looking for more ways to help players learn Arkheron. One way to do this was by introducing player-bots! These came together quickly and we’ve been experimenting with them in our pre-alpha playtests. Currently - they aren’t very polished and they are prone to acting up. [/p][p]
When our playtest weekend starts, in addition to playing the core Ascension Mode with human teams, you can also opt to join ‘Bot Ascension’ in our practice mode. This option lets you play Arkheron’s full game without any of the pressure of live matches. [/p][p][/p][p]It’s a good tool for getting used to the controls, experimenting with items and understanding the Tower and how to ascend it. However, the bots are still a work in progress and these matches are not the ideal way to experience Arkheron. It’s much more fun with other players, when you’re ready! 
[/p][p]Since we introduced bots for training purposes - it also presented an opportunity for us to use bots to help fill queues when we’re playtesting with smaller groups. You may occasionally see bots in Ascension games with other players - but you’ll be able to tell them apart by their nameplate. [b]
[/b][/p][p][b]MATCHMAKING[/b][/p][p]As we mentioned earlier, we’ve been hosting pre-alpha playtests for some time. As such, there’s a small number of players which means we haven’t been able to utilize matchmaking so far and that these players have quite a bit more experience with Arkheron than new players. [/p][p][/p][p]This is our first playtest with this version of our matchmaking system which means it won’t have much match data and will have some imperfections. It also has a lot of moving parts behind the scenes but what it essentially does is put new players up against other new players and keep the more experienced players away from them. When you first jump in, your matches may feel a bit uneven as the system works to figure out your skill level. The more you play, the more likely you are to have competitive matches. [/p][p][/p][p]New players will only match with other new players (of varying skill levels) until the system determines that they’re ready to advance. As new players get more experience throughout the playtest weekend, they’ll start being matched up with more experienced or competitive players. [/p][p][/p][p]Because the primary purpose of bots is for helping players learn Arkheron, you are more likely to see bots in a new player match if the queues are slow than you are if you’re playing in the upper skill groups. [/p][p][/p][p][b]REGION AND SERVER SUPPORT[/b][/p][p]As you may have seen in our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/"]Welcome to the Arkheron Alpha[/url] post yesterday, we have split this playtest weekend into three regions across the globe. In the longer term, we plan to have much more precise regional selections. While we work on getting there, we are using this region lock as a stopgap to help put some parameters on what sort of ping levels players may experience. [/p][p][/p][p]Based on your IP, we’ve chosen which region you fall into and you’ll only be able to play during that region’s playtest times and your ping may vary based on your location’s distance to one of the data centers. It is technically possible to play in another region’s playtest block if you are invited to join by a party leader from that region. 
[/p][p]Over time, we will be able to get more specific with regional support as more players join from that region. For example, South America is currently in the same region as North America - if we get a lot of players logging in from South America we would likely separate it out as a distinct region with servers that are closer. [/p][p][/p][p][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/p][p]It’s an Alpha! Arkheron’s core game loop is fun but there are definitely a few moving pieces that are still being fleshed out. We want you to know that these issues matter to us and we are actively working on their continued development. Some of these improvements can only come after testing with a wider audience and we greatly appreciate you coming along to help us![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the Arkheron Alpha!
notes.content:
[p]We are excited to reveal our upcoming game - Arkheron! In addition to this reveal, we’re also kicking off our Alpha Playtesting phase with a community playtest on Steam this weekend![/p][p]Arkheron is a team-based PvP game where 15 teams of three fight to ascend a mysterious Tower. Your team will work together to collect items, combine their powerful abilities and create unique builds on the fly to be the last team standing.[/p][p]Our playtests are currently only available on Steam. When Arkheron launches next year, it will be available on PC, PlayStation® 5 and Xbox™ Series X & S. [/p][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/"]Wishlist Now[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/"]Sign Up To Play[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/arkheron"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Arkheron - Official Reveal Trailer[/b][/h3][previewyoutube="2q-vxoejYf4;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]
Arkheron - Gameplay Overview[/b][/h3][previewyoutube="P9qIQY1ellA;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]
What to Expect from the Arkheron Alpha[/b][/h3][p]We’ve been hosting private playtests for some time now - but this is our first time sharing the details of Arkheron openly with the world! In this next phase, one of the key differences is that we’ll be able to seek feedback from a wider group because there’s no need to keep things under wraps.[/p][p]Prior playtests have given us a lot of helpful insights into how Arkheron plays with small groups and in highly competitive spaces. We’re now working on how we can make Arkheron more approachable to a larger group of players. This means things like our matchmaking systems are still close to a prototype phase. Arkheron also has a bit of a learning curve and we’re working on how to smooth that out for new players as well.   [/p][p]During this phase, we are still planning to experiment with various game mechanics and systems in Arkheron. Our team loves to throw ideas at the wall and see what sticks and what doesn’t. You may see work-in-progress content that isn’t final or limited prototypes of new things. This is part of the fun of the Alpha - we would love to get your feedback and offer the opportunity to help shape the game.  [/p][p]Some of the key things we’re still exploring are our patch building processes, server scaling, regional support and game balance! And we’re still working on finishing planned parts of Arkheron - like adding future support for colorblind mode and other accessibility features.   
[/p][p]We are also super interested in seeing how the meta changes with more players and more game time. We believe the core loop of Arkheron is fun - and now we're figuring out how to make sure it's a smooth experience that provides the most fun possible from login to logout.  
[/p][p]Let us know your thoughts over on Discord - [url="https://discord.gg/arkheron"]discord.gg/arkheron[/url]
[/p][h3][b]Join the Arkheron Playtest This Weekend![/b][/h3][p]If you’d like to jump in, you can sign up [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333850/Arkheron/"]here on Steam[/url] or [url="https://bonfire.firstlook.gg/"]through FirstLook[/url] if you prefer email. We will be sending out invites in waves - so if you don’t get one right away, just hang tight! We will also offer friend invites to those selected, so keep an eye out! [/p][p]If you’ve been invited to join the community, you can jump into [i]Training Mode[/i] now until the end of the weekend. This is our practice mode that lets you experiment with item combinations or jump into the sparring room for mini-matches up to 3v3 players. [/p][p][i]Ascension[/i] (Arkheron’s core game mode and the best way to experience our game!) will be up over the weekend from Friday through Sunday! Each region will have an allocated timeblock during each day. You’ll only be able to join the playtest during the allocated time period for your region. [/p][p]Alternatively, if someone from a different region invites you to join their party - you can join that region. Just note that if you’re playing outside of your dedicated region, your ping may be high! [/p][p][i]Please note that Arkheron is currently only available in English, Korean and Japanese. We will support more languages in the future![/i]
